critical_code_review_comments: server.py:4501-4520 — good: _is_adv_adjust_payment gate correctly skips paid_by_name/txn_center_id validation ONLY when body.request_type=='payment' AND rec.advance_request_id is set. Auto-fills paid_by_name/paid_by_user_id from the advance requester so downstream txn creation still has values. Clean.

server.py:4724-4765 — payment approval adjustment block: correctly increments adjusted_amount, decrements balance_amount (max(0,...)) and appends to adjustments[] with all requested fields (payment_id/quotation_id/qrn/amount/at/vendor_name/txn_id). Status flip logic (settled if balance<=0.01 else adjusting) is race-tolerant. Notification to advance owner fires on adjustment. MINOR: this update is non-atomic (find_one → compute → update_one). Under concurrent approvals of two payments against the same advance a small window could over-deduct. Consider $inc on adjusted_amount and $push on adjustments with a compare-current status flip via aggregation pipeline update. Not a blocker for MVP.
server.py:6898-6908 — create_payment advance validation correctly checks ownership + status in {released,adjusting} + balance sufficiency. Good.
server.py:6987-6993 — resubmit_payment re-validates balance. Confirmed via test that PaymentResubmitIn does NOT allow changing advance_request_id (immutable after create) — good invariant.

server.py:9323-9347 — GET /advance-requests/adjustable: correctly filters by created_by=user.id + status in {released,adjusting} + balance>0. Slim payload includes all requested fields. Sorted by released_at desc, limited to 50.

Advances.jsx / Quotations.jsx — all requested data-testids present (p-advance-toggle, p-advance-select, adv-adjusted-<id>, adv-balance-<id>). Dialog shows real-time 'After this payment' balance preview which is a nice UX touch.
MINOR: /api/transactions returns 500 for admin listing (pre-existing from iter-38) — did not block iter-39 (used direct DB read for txn assertions), but should be investigated independently.
